headline: Prove the staging archive contains exactly the admitted files

items.title: Verify exact staging archive members before upload
items.insight: The publisher currently checks archive bytes and a remote file count. A same-count substitution could pass. Verify the archive member list before uploading and preserve that proof in the staging receipt.
items.evidence: Actual archives accept exact names including spaces and long paths; reject missing, unexpected, duplicate and malformed members, unsafe source links/directories/traversal, corrupt or truncated archives. A real full staging deploy records matching inventory before upload; full required checks and production readback pass.
